dct_description_sm: To develop non-destructive methods for community-based monitoring of King Eider body condition in Ulukhaktok, NT.  If pilot work is successful, the resultant monitoring program will document changes in the body condition of King Eiders harvested at Ulukhaktok during the annual spring harvest over time.  Trends in body condition will then be analyzed against environmental changes (e.g. spring ice cover in the Cape Bathurst region) and used as an indication of annual productivity.
dct_title_s: Body condition data for King Eiders harvested in Ulukhatok, NT
